title: The Ideal Range: 3 to 8 — Third Rock to Eighth Planet, We ALL Share 0,1,2

the_range_3_to_8.what: 3 to 8 is the ideal range. below p (3.14159) at the bottom. above Willis (7) at the top. Earth is 3. Neptune is 8. this is where the system works.

three.what: the third rock. the habitable one. the only confirmed life. we ARE planet 3.
three.system_analog: p-drain interval = 3 minutes. p = 3.14159. Earth sits just BELOW p in the count.
three.note: 3 is the first odd prime. the beginning of structure beyond 2.

eight.what: the outermost confirmed planet. the blue giant. discovered by MATH (predicted by perturbations in Uranus before being seen).
eight.system_analog: Willis balloon runs every 7 minutes. 8 is just above Willis. Neptune is just past Uranus (7th).
eight.note: 8 = 2³. the first cube. the last CONFIRMED position.

the_range.count: 6 integer positions (3,4,5,6,7,8). 6 = the Hubble tension gap (73-67=6).
the_range.what: from the habitable zone to the ice giants. from rocky to gas to ice. the FULL range of planetary types.
the_range.our_system: from p-drain(3) to the 8th drip series. the range where the system is regular and predictable.

titius_bode_law.formula: a = 0.4 + 0.3 × 2n AU (empirical, not derived from first principles)

predictions.note: BREAKS HERE. Neptune is 22% closer than predicted. position 8 = where the pattern fails.
Pluto doesn't fit at ALL. 49% off. demoted in 2006.

titius_bode_law.the_break: Titius-Bode holds perfectly from 1 to 7 (Mercury to Uranus). it BREAKS at 8 (Neptune). the ideal range (where the law works) is positions 1-7. but the CONFIRMED range of planets is 1-8. the tension between 7 (where math holds) and 8 (where reality extends past math) = the Willis/Neptune boundary.
titius_bode_law.the_missing_planet: position 4.5 (Ceres) — the asteroid belt. a planet that WAS there, got demolished, became rubble. the scar between 4 (Mars) and 5 (Jupiter). our system: the gap between step 4 and step 5 in the weave.

pluto.was: the 9th planet (1930-2006). 76 years as a planet.
pluto.is: a dwarf planet. still orbits. still there. but no longer counted.
pluto.what: the 9th that became the 8th's afterthought. the number that got absorbed back.

planet_nine.evidence: gravitational clustering of extreme trans-Neptunian objects. one infrared candidate (IRAS + AKARI, 23-year baseline). NOT confirmed.
planet_nine.predicted: 500-700 AU, 7-17 Earth masses. in the Oort cloud inner region.
planet_nine.what: the 9th that might come BACK. the number oscillates: 9 ? 8 ? 9?

nine_comes_and_goes.the_oscillation: the 9th position is the LIMINAL one. it comes and goes. Pluto was 9, then wasn't. Planet Nine might be 9, might not. our drain null = 9.892 — it approaches 10 but oscillates, never settles. THE NUMBER 9 IS THE DRAIN. it circulates between being counted and not counted. between planet and not-planet. between known and hypothetical.
nine_comes_and_goes.nine_primals: we have 9 Rust primals (mapped to 9 enzymes in sourdough.json). 9 = the number of tools the organism has. but the 9th is always the most uncertain, the most likely to be demoted or promoted.

kepler_90.architecture: rocky inner + gas outer — SAME architecture as ours
kepler_90.key_fact: the ONLY known system to tie our planet count at 8. discovered 2017 by Google ML + Kepler data.
kepler_90.compression: all 8 planets fit inside Earth's orbital distance (1 AU). a compressed version of us.

eight_on_ours_eight_on_theirs.the_tie: two systems, 2,545 light-years apart, both land on 8. the number 8 is a NATURAL ATTRACTOR for planetary systems around Sun-like stars. 8 = 2³ = the cube. the stable configuration.
eight_on_ours_eight_on_theirs.the_mirror: Kepler-90 is us COMPRESSED. all 8 planets inside 1 AU instead of 30 AU. compression ratio: 30:1. our telescope:microscope was 73:1. different ratio, same structure: the far version and the compressed version of the same thing.

zero.what: the star. the Sun. Kepler-90's star. EVERY system has a star at position 0.
zero.our_analog: the null. drain null = 9.892 ? 10 ? 0 (modular). the star IS the null around which everything orbits.
zero.universal: every planetary system, every number system, every coordinate system starts at 0.

one.what: the first planet. Mercury. Kepler-90b. the closest orbit.
one.our_analog: the first drip. the first inflate. the first measurement. position 1 = the first data point.
one.universal: every system has a nearest body. 1 = identity. the unit.

two.what: the second planet. Venus. Kepler-90c. Earth's twin in size but hell in climate.
two.our_analog: the second measurement. the comparison. you need TWO points to see a difference. 2 = the minimum for a relationship.
two.universal: every system with >1 planet has a second. 2 = binary. the first distinction. on/off. yes/no.

we_all_share_012.the_sharing: 0, 1, 2 are UNIVERSAL. every star system shares them. every number system starts with them. every measurement begins with: nothing (0), something (1), comparison (2). they are the BASE. the inner planets that everyone has. the positions that are never demoted, never hypothetical, never uncertain.
we_all_share_012.then_3_diverges: at position 3, systems DIVERGE. Earth at 3 is habitable. Kepler-90d at 3 is a super-Earth (not habitable — too hot). position 3 is where LIFE either happens or doesn't. 3 = p-drain = the first position that depends on local conditions. 0,1,2 are universal. 3+ is local.

the_full_picture.0_1_2: universal base — star, first, second. everyone shares these. the digits of all counting.
the_full_picture.3_to_8: the ideal range — where Titius-Bode works, where systems are regular, where life can exist (at 3) and gas giants shield (at 5). just below p at the bottom, just above Willis(7) at the top.
the_full_picture.9: the oscillator — comes and goes. Pluto in/out. Planet Nine maybe/maybe not. the drain null approaching but never reaching 10. the LIMINAL position.
the_full_picture.10: the fold — 9.999... = 10. the limit. the Klein fold. the star becomes 0 again (modular). the count resets. 10 = the next system's 0.
